lines.text: When the Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem and found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple courts.
Jesus made a whip out of reeds, drove everyone out, overturned the tables, and told the dove sellers to leave.
His disciples remembered the Scripture about zeal for God's house, and the Jews demanded a sign to prove His authority.
Jesus said He would raise the temple in three days, and the Jews said it took forty years to build.
After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered His words, but Jesus did not entrust Himself to the people, for He knew them all.
